root_cause: A placeholder API key for an embedding provider was accepted at startup because the factory did not probe the credential. The first real embed call failed mid-cycle, after the provider had already been selected and other work had been done.

details.rule: Any external service integration must probe the credential on startup with a cheap call and refuse to select the provider when the probe fails. Placeholder values must be rejected explicitly, not silently degraded to a fallback that hides the failure.
